description: Defines constants, string conversions, and utility functions related to cookies, including cookie priorities, same-site attributes, port ranges, and URL scheme identification.

methods.name: CookiePriorityToString
methods.description: Converts a CookiePriority enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookiePriority
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding CookiePriority enum value.

methods.name: CookieSameSiteToString
methods.description: Converts a CookieSameSite enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookieSameSite
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the CookieSameSite enum value and sets the samesite_string accordingly.

methods.name: RecordCookieSameSiteAttributeValueHistogram
methods.description: Records a histogram metric for the Cookie SameSite attribute value.

methods.name: ReducePortRangeForCookieHistogram
methods.description: Maps a port number to a reduced port category for histogram purposes.

methods.name: GetSchemeNameEnum
methods.description: Determines the scheme name enum for a given URL based on its scheme.
